sources.title: HPA v25.1 hpa tissue RNA
sources.description: Human Protein Atlas RNA sequencing in normal human tissues. Gene-level normalized RNA abundance in nTPM; independent HPA tissue collection.

sources.title: HPA v25.1 gtex tissue RNA
sources.description: GTEx normal human tissue RNA sequencing, distributed by the Human Protein Atlas. Gene-level normalized RNA abundance in nTPM from a separate donor collection.

sources.title: HPA v25.1 consensus tissue RNA
sources.description: Human Protein Atlas consensus normal tissue RNA expression. Maximum normalized nTPM across HPA and GTEx, not an independent replication or an average.

method: Exact Gene name filter, all tissue rows; retain nTPM unchanged; no donor-level data.
